summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, reporting the completion of its board leadership transition. Effective July 30, 2026, Steven Reid stepped down as Chair and from the Board after 13 years of service, as part of a previously announced succession and renewal process. Dan Myerson, who joined the board following the acquisition of Foran Mining, was appointed Chair, with Patrick Godin named Lead Independent Director. This is a routine governance change, not a forced departure, with no deal terms or special-situation transaction involved.
